source.sqlReaderQuery:

COUNT(*) CNT 
FROM 
D360.STG_EDS_TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION WHERE H = 'D'

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION_SELECT_SRC
(
				 [SUBSCRIPTION_ID]
				,[BR_CD]
				,[BASE_NO]
				,[LAST6_BASE_NO]
				,[SUBSCRIPTION_NAME]
				,[PRODUCT_ID]
				,[PURPOSE]
				,[INCEPTION_DATE]
				,[MARKETING_OFFICER]
				,[STATUS]
				,[PAYMENT_TYPE]
				,[RC_DIVISION]
				,[REFERRED_BY]
				,[REVIEW_DATE]
				,[DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION]
				,[TBG_REFERRAL]
				,[FEE_SERVICE]
				,[MAKER_ID]
				,[MAKER_DATE]
				,[AUTH_ID]
				,[AUTH_DATE]
				,[REJECT_REASON]
				,[TRUST_AGMT_EXT]
				,[TRUST_AGMT_INT]
				,[MANDATE]
				,[IS_BLACKLISTED]
				,[BLACKLISTED_DATE]
				,[BASE_NO_UNMASKED]
				,[SUB_BR_CD]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
				 CC.[SUBSCRIPTION_ID]
				,CC.[BR_CD]
				,CC.[BASE_NO]
				,CC.[LAST6_BASE_NO]
				,CC.[SUBSCRIPTION_NAME]
				,CC.[PRODUCT_ID]
				,CC.[PURPOSE]
				,CC.[INCEPTION_DATE]
				,CC.[MARKETING_OFFICER]
				,CC.[STATUS]
				,CC.[PAYMENT_TYPE]
				,CC.[RC_DIVISION]
				,CC.[REFERRED_BY]
				,CC.[REVIEW_DATE]
				,CC.[DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION]
				,CC.[TBG_REFERRAL]
				,CC.[FEE_SERVICE]
				,CC.[MAKER_ID]
				,CC.[MAKER_DATE]
				,CC.[AUTH_ID]
				,CC.[AUTH_DATE]
				,CC.[REJECT_REASON]
				,CC.[TRUST_AGMT_EXT]
				,CC.[TRUST_AGMT_INT]
				,CC.[MANDATE]
				,CC.[IS_BLACKLISTED]
				,CC.[BLACKLISTED_DATE]
				,CC.[BASE_NO_UNMASKED]
				,CC.[SUB_BR_CD]
				,CC.[FILE_NAME]
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION CC
			JOIN d360.STG_EDS_TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION B 
			ON CC.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = B.SUBSCRIPTION_ID
			AND CC.BASE_NO = B.BASE_NO
			AND CC.BNK_CODE = LEFT(B.FILE_NAME,5)
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';
	

TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION_GROUP_SRC
(
				 [SUBSCRIPTION_ID]
				,[BR_CD]
				,[BASE_NO]
				,[LAST6_BASE_NO]
				,[SUBSCRIPTION_NAME]
				,[PRODUCT_ID]
				,[PURPOSE]
				,[INCEPTION_DATE]
				,[MARKETING_OFFICER]
				,[STATUS]
				,[PAYMENT_TYPE]
				,[RC_DIVISION]
				,[REFERRED_BY]
				,[REVIEW_DATE]
				,[DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION]
				,[TBG_REFERRAL]
				,[FEE_SERVICE]

				,[MAKER_DATE]
				,[AUTH_ID]
				,[AUTH_DATE]

				,[BASE_NO_UNMASKED]
				,[SUB_BR_CD]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT 
				,FILE_DATE
)

select 
				 [SUBSCRIPTION_ID]
				,[BR_CD]
				,[BASE_NO]
				,[LAST6_BASE_NO]
				,[SUBSCRIPTION_NAME]
				,[PRODUCT_ID]
				,[PURPOSE]
				,[INCEPTION_DATE]
				,[MARKETING_OFFICER]
				,[STATUS]
				,[PAYMENT_TYPE]
				,[RC_DIVISION]
				,[REFERRED_BY]
				,[REVIEW_DATE]
				,[DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION]
				,[TBG_REFERRAL]
				,[FEE_SERVICE]
				,[MAKER_ID]
				,[MAKER_DATE]
				,[AUTH_ID]
				,[AUTH_DATE]
				,[REJECT_REASON]
				,[TRUST_AGMT_EXT]
				,[TRUST_AGMT_INT]
				,[MANDATE]
				,[IS_BLACKLISTED]
				,[BLACKLISTED_DATE]
				,[BASE_NO_UNMASKED]
				,[SUB_BR_CD]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
				 [SUBSCRIPTION_ID]
				,[BR_CD]
				,[BASE_NO]
				,[LAST6_BASE_NO]
				,[SUBSCRIPTION_NAME]
				,[PRODUCT_ID]
				,[PURPOSE]
				,[INCEPTION_DATE]
				,[MARKETING_OFFICER]
				,[STATUS]
				,[PAYMENT_TYPE]
				,[RC_DIVISION]
				,[REFERRED_BY]
				,[REVIEW_DATE]
				,[DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION]
				,[TBG_REFERRAL]
				,[FEE_SERVICE]
				,[MAKER_ID]
				,[MAKER_DATE]
				,[AUTH_ID]
				,[AUTH_DATE]
				,[REJECT_REASON]
				,[TRUST_AGMT_EXT]
				,[TRUST_AGMT_INT]
				,[MANDATE]
				,[IS_BLACKLISTED]
				,[BLACKLISTED_DATE]
				,[BASE_NO_UNMASKED]
				,[SUB_BR_CD]
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME 
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY     [SUBSCRIPTION_ID]
				,[BR_CD]
				,[BASE_NO]
				,[LAST6_BASE_NO]
				,[SUBSCRIPTION_NAME]
				,[PRODUCT_ID]
				,[PURPOSE]
				,[INCEPTION_DATE]
				,[MARKETING_OFFICER]
				,[STATUS]
				,[PAYMENT_TYPE]
				,[RC_DIVISION]
				,[REFERRED_BY]
				,[REVIEW_DATE]
				,[DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION]
				,[TBG_REFERRAL]
				,[FEE_SERVICE]
				,[MAKER_ID]
				,[MAKER_DATE]
				,[AUTH_ID]
				,[AUTH_DATE]
				,[REJECT_REASON]
				,[TRUST_AGMT_EXT]
				,[TRUST_AGMT_INT]
				,[MANDATE]
				,[IS_BLACKLISTED]
				,[BLACKLISTED_DATE]
				,[BASE_NO_UNMASKED]
				,[SUB_BR_CD]
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.SUBSCRIPTION_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.SUBSCRIPTION_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BASE_NO,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BASE_NO,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1

				,[DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION]

				,[FEE_SERVICE]
				,[MAKER_ID]

				,[AUTH_ID]

				,[REJECT_REASON]
				,[TRUST_AGMT_EXT]
				,[TRUST_AGMT_INT]
				,[MANDATE]
				,[IS_BLACKLISTED]
				,[BLACKLISTED_DATE]
				,[BASE_NO_UNMASKED]

				,'9999-12-31'
				,1
				,1
				,LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5)
				,'TRU'
				,SRC.FILE_NAME
				,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
